issues.issue: Which facts underlying refugee-risk factors may be considered under s.25(1) once s.25(1.3) applies (certified Q1)?
issues.respondent_position: Minister's reading of ss.25(1) and 25(1.3) is substantially correct and was adopted below.
issues.result_quote: may not be considered under subsection 25(1) by virtue of subsection 25(1.3).

issues.issue: Is s.25(1.3) invalid under Charter ss.7 and 15 or the rule of law?
issues.applicant_position: Subsection 25(1.3) breaches Charter ss.7 and 15 and the rule of law.
issues.result_quote: I reject the Lemus family’s Charter challenge.

issues.issue: Was the Officer's refusal of H&C relief under s.25(1) reasonable?
issues.applicant_position: Officer did not assess hardship from the risk facts, so the refusal was unreasonable.
issues.respondent_position: Record supports the outcome; asks the court to supplement the reasons.
issues.result_quote: It follows that the Officer’s decision is unreasonable and the matter should be sent back for redetermination.

issues.issue: Can facts underlying protection claims be used when assessing hardship under s.25(1.3) (certified Q2)?
issues.applicant_position: Officer wrongly ignored risk-related facts when assessing hardship.
issues.result_quote: No. All facts related to the hardships may be provided and considered.
In my view, there are no special reasons for an award of costs under section 22
